detect_openclaw_residue: check if an OpenClaw workspace directory exists in the user home folder
mark_seen: persist an onboarding flag to config.yaml so a first-touch hint is never shown again
is_seen: check whether a given onboarding hint flag has already been shown to the user
busy_input_hint_gateway: generate a gateway-style onboarding hint explaining busy input modes like queue or steer
tool_progress_hint_cli: generate a CLI onboarding tip that teaches the user to use the verbose command
